title: 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RA_0LB---: what a change of era hands on to the base-3 counter
text: At each change of era N loses d base-3 digits and becomes ⌊N/3<sup>d</sup>⌋ + 1. When d > 0 it is fixed by N: read from its lowest digit, N starts with a zeros, one digit 1 or 2, b twos and one more digit, and the change eats exactly that block (d = a + b + 2). Whether d = 0 is decided by the state in which the head returns to the left end after the carry runs off the chain. Checked at 1,000 changes of era (no halt) and at 200 of 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RA_0LE---, except a few while N is short. A closed form for the kind of change is open.
